# [TASK] Live-verify ai-service against the real stack (Ollama, Postman/newman, e2e-smoke scope)

## Parent Story
Parent: #93

## Task
Live-verify ai-service's three Ollama-backed endpoints (recommendations, chat, semantic search) through the real gateway. Speech-to-text (#68) and the gateway-routing bug that blocked ai-service (#69) were already fixed and out of scope here.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Root `README.md` documents the Ollama model-pull step (`ollama pull llama3.2`, `ollama pull nomic-embed-text`)
- [x] Postman collection has an ai-service folder covering recommendations, chat, and semantic search, chained off the bearer token from folder 8 (User Service - Auth)
- [x] All three endpoints (`/api/v1/ai/recommendations`, `/api/v1/ai/chat`, `/api/v1/ai/search/semantic`) verified through the gateway with a real, non-mocked Ollama round-trip
- [x] `e2e-smoke.yml` / `smoke-test.sh` ai-service scope decided and documented — wired in (`HEALTH_TARGETS`, model-pull step, time budget noted)

## Verification
Pulled `llama3.2` and `nomic-embed-text` into a running Ollama container, brought the full local stack up, and called all three endpoints through the gateway (`:8080`) with a real registered user's bearer token. Then ran the full Postman collection via `smoke-test.sh` against the live stack: 74/74 requests, 82/82 assertions passing on a clean run.

Found and fixed a real bug in the process: `RestClientConfig`'s `@LoadBalanced` was on the already-built `RestClient` bean, not its `RestClient.Builder` — Spring Cloud LoadBalancer never post-processed it, so every call to `lb://movie-service` threw `Unroutable protocol scheme: lb://movie-service`, and recommendations silently returned an empty list in every real deployment (masked by the unit tests, which bypassed `lb://` resolution entirely). Fixed in 8f44ebe, hardened in 44f82c6 after independent review caught that an interim version of the fix leaked load-balancing onto Eureka's own registration client and Spring AI's Ollama client (both started failing with "No servers available for service: discovery-service/ollama"). `AiServiceIntegrationTest` now exercises the real `lb://` resolution path via Spring Cloud's `SimpleDiscoveryClient` instead of bypassing it — an independent review agent confirmed empirically that reverting the fix makes the test fail with the original symptom, and restoring it passes again.

## Known limitation
Recommendations occasionally return HTTP 500 because `llama3.2` (a small local model, no strict JSON mode) sometimes doesn't format its response as valid JSON matching the expected schema (`MismatchedInputException` / `UnexpectedEndOfInputException` in the logs). Confirmed this is model output variability, not a wiring or code bug — retrying the exact same request succeeds. Chat and semantic search haven't shown this. Worth a follow-up issue if reliability under a small local LLM becomes a priority (e.g. retry-on-parse-failure in `RecommendationService`).

## Notes
- Speech-to-text is out of scope here — already covered by #68/#69.
